Baseball Heroes.name: Baseball Heroes
Baseball Heroes.summary: Hit, run, dive, jump, catch and throw. Pitch for the strikeout record and swing for the fences! Play baseball against the Lynx or take on a friend. Four different games with super graphics!

Klax.name: Klax
Klax.summary: Klax is a 1989 computer puzzle game designed by Dave Akers and Mark Stephen Pierce. The object is to line up colored blocks into rows of similar colors to make them disappear, to which the object of Columns is similar. Atari Games originally released it as a coin-op follow up to Tetris, about which they were tangled in a legal dispute at the time.
